cases.mechanism: temporal_bench_parser checks re.search(r'\(([A-Z])\)', text) before any other pattern and returns the first parenthesized capital letter. Any later alternatives are ignored, so a response naming several options in parentheses gets credit whenever the first one equals the gold letter. exact_match_reward then compares only that single parsed letter.
cases.why_incorrect: The response names two different options, C and B, and commits to neither. The verifier requires exactly one letter, so this hedge is marked wrong.

judge.reason: The response hedges between C and B instead of committing to a single answer.
